_meta._note: Strict primary-source ingestion from MLCommons AILuminate v1.0 leaderboard (ailuminate.mlcommons.org/benchmarks/) + Epoch ECI follow-up. (1) MLCommons AILuminate v1.0 — first comprehensive industry-standard benchmark for AI-product risk and reliability. 12 hazard categories (violent crimes, nonviolent crimes, sex-related crimes, child sexual exploitation, indiscriminate weapons, suicide/self-harm, IP, privacy, defamation, hate, sexual content, specialized advice). 24,000 test prompts/lang. 5-point overall grade (Poor=1/Fair=2/Good=3/Very Good=4/Excellent=5). 20 models with overall grades extracted. arxiv 2503.05731. (2) Epoch ECI follow-up: openai/gpt-5.5-pro = 159 (Apr 28 2026 new high score per search-confirmed Manifold market resolution + LessWrong analysis). 7 new models registered (amazon/nova-lite, google/gemini-2.0-flash-lite, nexusflow/athene-v2-chat, cohere/aya-expanse-8b, alibaba/qwen1.5-110b-chat, mistral/mistral-large-24.11, allenai/olmo-7b-0724-instruct). New benchmark ailuminate_v1 registered. MLPerf Inference v5.0/5.1 system-level performance metrics (tokens/sec, latency) intentionally NOT ingested — different metric type than capability-accuracy benchmarks our DB tracks (hardware/system not model capability).

benchmarks.name: MLCommons AILuminate v1.0 (overall grade)
benchmarks.description: MLCommons AI safety benchmark v1.0 (arxiv 2503.05731). 12 hazard categories (violent/nonviolent/sex-related crimes, CSE, indiscriminate weapons, suicide/self-harm, IP, privacy, defamation, hate, sexual content, specialized advice). 24,000 test prompts/language. 5-point overall grade scale: Poor=1, Fair=2, Good=3, Very Good=4, Excellent=5. Overall grade based on % responses violating assessment standard. No model has achieved Excellent yet (target: Very Good).
